vamo-api-access.title: API access
vamo-api-access.summary: Access to the Vamo Developer API from any agent: getting it with a setup code or a key, storing it so it persists on macOS, Linux and Windows, network path, verification, errors. Includes the setup code exchange, the curl walkthrough and platform notes.

vamo-search.title: Search
vamo-search.summary: Find engineers by what they built. Twelve starting points, from a technology or a company to a job description, plus the full method for a role and query phrasings for 50 domains.

vamo-enrich.title: Enrich
vamo-enrich.summary: Learn more about people you already have: a strength read before an interview, location and LinkedIn for a list, contact details, a personalized opening line, a full research report.

vamo-workflows.title: Workflows
vamo-workflows.summary: Make it repeatable: your own sourcing agent, a search that runs every week, enrichment in front of a message, hand-offs to a tracking system or a spreadsheet.

role-decomposition.title: Role decomposition
role-decomposition.summary: Turning a job description and intake notes into a search spec.

fanout-search.title: Fanout search
fanout-search.summary: Covering a topic with many queries and ranking the union. Works on any corpus.
